emissionRules: Emit once on half-open phase entry, deduplicate by episodeId+phaseId+kind+tick; emit tick0 once.

losslessCropAdapterProposal.rule: After source freeze, measure each frame alpha support, retained nonzero RGB if preservation required, and annotation bounds. Crop losslessly with exact original-canvas offsets. Never threshold alpha, reduce colors, drop faint pixels, move anchors or independently fit bodies.
losslessCropAdapterProposal.renderOrigin: original full-canvas origin +cropRect[x,y]/density; cropPivot=originalPivot-cropOrigin. Reconstruct exact full frame to verify no world-position change. Keep offsets signed if a pivot is outside the crop.
losslessCropAdapterProposal.budgetMeasurement: Measure actual distinct retained frame crop areas/packed texture area and current schema semantics separately. Variable atlas packing or cropped-area accounting requires explicit new adapter validation, not a claim that old canvas*count budget accepts it.
losslessCropAdapterProposal.binaryPaletteWarning: Lossless crop does not cure partial alpha or >64 colors. Preserve originals; any reviewed pixel cleanup is a separate future derivative and cannot be called lossless.
losslessCropAdapterProposal.passClaim: PENDING exact source measurements and current Mac technical review; no automatic admission or budget pass.
